description: New Hampshire Coastal Adaptation Workgroup Website is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by New Hampshire Department of Environmental Services; New Hampshire Coastal Program; NOAA, National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration. Municipal officials, educators, and citizens can use this site to quickly connect to information about how to reduce the risk of damage from coastal hazards and get involved with coastal adaptation projects in New Hampshire. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Changing Seasons, Erosion and Shoreline Recession, Flooding – Coastal, Shifting Species, Habitats, and Ecosystems. Assets: Cultural and Community Services, Economy, Natural Areas and Wildlife, People, Property, Urban Landscape and Tree Canopy, Water Infrastructure – Stormwater. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
